title: First Woman to Play at Lord's Cricket Ground
summary: The first woman to play a test match at the Lord's cricket ground, Crati Goud, made history by becoming the first woman to be named on the Lords' Honours Board. This achievement marks a significant milestone in women's cricket and comes after years of facing discrimination and marginalization. The recognition is seen as a step towards promoting equality and respect for women in sports.
summary_points: Crati Goud became the first woman to play a test match at Lord's Cricket Ground
She was named on the Lords' Honours Board, marking a significant milestone in women's cricket
The recognition comes after years of facing discrimination and marginalization in sports
It is seen as a step towards promoting equality and respect for women in sports
Crati Goud's achievement marks a new era for women's cricket in India
title_hi: लॉर्ड्स क्रिकेट ग्राउंड पर पहली महिला खेलने वाली
summary_hi: लॉर्ड्स क्रिकेट ग्राउंड पर पहली महिला खेलने वाली क्राति गौड़ ने इतिहास रचा, लॉर्ड्स के ऑनर बोर्ड पर नाम दर्ज कराने वाली पहली महिला बनीं। यह उपलब्धि महिलाओं के क्रिकेट में समानता और सम्मान को बढ़ावा देने का एक महत्वपूर्ण कदम है।
summary_points_hi: क्राति गौड़ लॉर्ड्स क्रिकेट ग्राउंड पर पहली महिला खेलने वाली बनीं
उन्हें लॉर्ड्स के ऑनर बोर्ड पर नाम दर्ज कराने वाली पहली महिला माना जाता है
यह उपलब्धि महिलाओं को स्पोर्ट्स में भेदभाव और असमानता का सामना करने के बाद एक महत्वपूर्ण कदम है
यह एक समानता और सम्मान को बढ़ावा देने की ओर एक महत्वपूर्ण कदम है
क्राति गौड़ की उपलब्धि महिलाओं के क्रिकेट में नई युग की शुरुआत करती है

framing.center: Centrist outlets focus on the historical significance of this achievement, noting that it marks a new era for women's cricket in India. They emphasize the importance of recognizing and celebrating achievements like Crati Goud's, which can inspire others to pursue their passions and interests.
framing.right: Right-leaning outlets frame this achievement as a victory for women's empowerment and a challenge to traditional notions of masculinity in sports. They highlight the significance of Crati Goud's recognition as a symbol of female strength and determination.
